config.likelihood: rubberband (lower convex hull) over 950-1800 cm^-1, then cut to 1600-1700; y_w ~ N(s * m_w + c0, sigma^2 I) with s and c0 profiled out by linear least squares at every call and sigma exact. Pre-registered in docs/EXPERIMENTS.md E1 step 3 (redesign 2026-11-06). This replaces vector normalisation with sigma_pp = sigma / ||y_w||, whose effective sigma saturated at ~0.049 AU under heavy noise and which was biased by the rubberband lifting noisy data by +2.1 sigma (results/e1/superseded_phi_0.05_0.90/, 810bba6).
